dogecoin.text:
Bitcoin price surges to $67,000 on as ETF inflows bolster momentum! 🚀 

The crypto market shows strong upward trends today, with BTC reaching daily highs and meme coins like $DOGE and $SHIB rallying. 

Total market cap jumps 3.48% to $2.42T.

. @dogecoin's open interest (OI) surged 19% to $647.19M, reaching a monthly high as prices "break out" on July 20. Traders are boosting $DOGE positions amid this surge, but not all see a confirmed bullish pattern.

✜ "DOGE is poised for a strong upward move," said trader Shelby.
